description: Read an institutional manager's original 13F-HR information table. company is the filer: a 10-digit CIK, ticker, or name; names outside the ticker file use EDGAR entity search, and ambiguous names return candidates. For managers holding an issuer, use secedgar_find_holders and pass its filer_cik here. Positions carry issuer, CUSIP, shares, whole-USD market value, and option designation. Same-period amendments are disclosed separately, never merged; read them with secedgar_get_filing. By default, sub-lines consolidate into positions sorted by value; consolidate=false preserves raw filing order. Page with limit, offset and returned next_offset. When canvas is available, the original report's full parsed positions are staged as df_<id>: inspect with secedgar_dataframe_describe, then aggregate or join on cusip + reporting_period with secedgar_dataframe_query. Managers below $100M in 13(f) securities may not file. Use secedgar_search_filings with forms=["13F-HR"] for broader search.

company.description: The institutional filer whose 13F to fetch — a 10-digit CIK (e.g. "0000102909" for VANGUARD GROUP INC, the most reliable form), a ticker, or an entity name. A name is matched against the registrants in EDGAR's ticker file first (current and former names) and, when none match, resolved through EDGAR entity search, which covers institutional managers absent from that file; a name matching several filers (some legal names are shared across entities) returns those candidates so you can retry with the exact CIK. This is NOT the portfolio company — passing an issuer ticker like "AAPL" finds that operating company's own filings (it files no 13F), not who holds it; use secedgar_find_holders for that direction.

consolidate.description: When true (default), info-table sub-lines for the same security (CUSIP + class + put/call) are summed into one position and results are sorted by market value descending, so `limit` returns the largest distinct holdings. Set false to return raw information-table rows in filing order (one per investment-discretion/manager sub-line), preserving investment_discretion.

limit.description: Maximum number of holdings rows to return. 13F filings from large institutions can contain thousands of positions. Default 20.

offset.description: Row to start the page at, 0-based, over the ordered position list. Pass the next_offset from the previous response to read the next page — the filing is parsed whole and sliced, so paging is stable and gap-free. An offset at or past the position count returns an empty page.

quarter.description: Reporting quarter to target, in "YYYY-QN" format (e.g., "2025-Q4"), matched exactly against each 13F-HR's period of report. When omitted, returns the most recent 13F-HR in the submissions feed's recent window (the last year or 1,000 filings, whichever holds more). Quarters map to the filing window: Q4 2025 = filings submitted roughly Jan–Mar 2026. A quarter older than the recent window is looked up in the archive, reading forward from the quarter end up to 10 archive pages. A quarter the manager covered with a 13F-NT notice (holdings reported by other managers) fails naming that notice.

name: secedgar_get_institutional_holdings

accession_number.description: Accession number of this 13F-HR — pass to secedgar_get_filing.

amendment_search_complete.description: False if archive discovery was bounded or unavailable.

amendments.description: Known amendments to the original report. Absent when none were found.

items.description: Same-period amendment; its holdings are not merged.

unavailable_reason.description: Why the type is unavailable; inspect with secedgar_get_filing.

dataset.description: Original-report positions, shaped by consolidate; join on cusip + reporting_period. Amendment positions are excluded. Absent without canvas or holdings.

name.description: Dataframe handle (df_XXXXX_XXXXX) for secedgar_dataframe_describe, then secedgar_dataframe_query.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `company_not_found`: The company input does not resolve to a known company or institution. `ambiguous_entity`: The name resolves to multiple EDGAR entities (e.g. several filers sharing a legal name). `no_filings_found`: No 13F-HR matches — the entity files none, none exists for the requested quarter in the recent submissions window or the archive pages searched, or the manager filed a 13F-NT notice instead (for the requested quarter, or as its only recent 13F filing when no quarter is given). `no_info_table`: The 13F-HR filing was found but the information table XML document could not be located. `rate_limited`: SEC is rate-limiting this server's IP — SEC answered 429, or the call was refused without being sent while the cool-down after one runs. `sec_unreachable`: SEC EDGAR gave no complete, readable response — on the last attempt made (the third, or an earlier one once this call's 40-second budget for SEC failures ran out) the connection failed, no response headers arrived within 15 seconds, or the body broke off or stalled for 15 seconds, each wait capped at what was left of that budget; a 200 body was not the JSON SEC serves; or earlier SEC failures had spent that budget, so the request was never sent. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filer_cik.description: CIK of the 13F filer, zero-padded to 10 digits.

filer_name.description: Name of the institutional filer (the 13F submitter).

holdings.description: `limit` rows from `offset`: positions by market value when consolidate=true, else raw rows in filing order.

items.description: One row from the 13F information table.

investment_discretion.description: SOLE sole, DFND shared/advised, OTR other. Absent if unreported or consolidated.

issuer_name.description: Name of the issuer whose securities are held.

market_value_usd.description: Whole USD at report date; pre-2023-01-03 filing values scaled from thousands. Absent if unreported.

put_call.description: Present only on a put or call option position.

shares_or_principal_amount.description: Shares or debt principal. Absent if unreported.

shares_or_principal_type.description: SH shares; PRN debt principal. Absent if unreported.

title_of_class.description: Security class (COM, CL A, ETF). Absent if unreported.

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page. Absent on the last page.

notice.description: Amendment disclosure, incomplete discovery, paging, and dataframe guidance.

offset.description: Row the returned page starts at, 0-based.

reporting_period.description: Cover-page quarter end (YYYY-MM-DD). Absent if omitted.

total_holdings_in_filing.description: Original raw row count before consolidation or paging.

total_positions.description: Distinct positions before paging. Only with consolidate=true.

truncated.description: True when the inline holdings[] was capped by limit.

title: Get Institutional Holdings
